data.long_meaning: The name Cornelius is derived from the Latin name Cornelius, which was a Roman surname meaning 'horn of the moon god.' The name Cornelius carries the meaning “horn of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cornelius usually hope their child will grow to embody horn of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
